section.catchline: Purpose statement -- Definitions -- Scope of part.
section.subsection: In relation to the tax imposed by this part, the legislative findings described in Section 59-12-701 apply similarly to cities and towns as the findings apply to counties.
The definitions of Section 59-12-702 are incorporated into this part.
This part applies only to a city or town that is located within a county of the second, third, fourth, fifth, or sixth class as designated in Section 17-60-104.
